name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
summary: In Dolanaar, Zarrin teaches young cooks to gather only what they need from Teldrassil's woods. His lesson begins with food and the forest, not the battlefield.

sections.title: Children of the Stars
sections.body: Behind the inn in Dolanaar, Zarrin tends a bubbling cauldron and teaches young adventurers the traditions of his people. Night elves once called themselves the kaldorei, or children of the stars. Zarrin begins with their bond to food and Teldrassil's boughs, and leaves the battlefield aside.

sections.title: Taking Only What Is Needed
sections.body: Outside Shadowglen, Zarrin asks you to gather exactly seven small spider legs from woodland arachnids. The kaldorei seek harmony with nature by taking only what they need and treating the wild with kindness. Even in troubled times, that balance matters. A spider kabob makes the lesson plain.

faq.answer: Zarrin is a night elf who tends a cauldron behind the inn in Dolanaar. He teaches young adventurers to cook in keeping with kaldorei traditions.

faq.q: Why does Zarrin insist on collecting exactly seven spider legs?
faq.answer: Zarrin asks for exactly seven spider legs to teach that the kaldorei take only what they need and live in harmony with nature. The lesson calls for respect for the living forest and its balance.
Kaldorei means children of the stars in the Darnassian tongue. It is the ancient name night elves have used for themselves for thousands of years.

faq.q: Where are the spider legs gathered?
faq.answer: Gather the legs from webwood spiders in Teldrassil's forests, outside Shadowglen's sheltered borders.

faq.q: What do night elves prepare with spider legs?
faq.answer: Zarrin teaches young adventurers to prepare Kaldorei Spider Kabobs, a traditional wilderness dish made from woodland spider meat for a nourishing meal on the road.

faq.q: Do all spiders in Teldrassil yield the legs needed?
faq.answer: No. Immature spiders in Shadowglen do not yield the proper legs for Zarrin's recipe. Gather them from spiders roaming Teldrassil's wider woods.

angles.text: Learning to cook in Teldrassil brings you the recipe for Kaldorei Spider Kabobs.
As a night elf, you learn the kaldorei way: keep harmony with nature through restraint, and take only what you need.
